non_fungible.granularity_rule_zh: 零積之十功不能折一次之十過也。
non_fungible.granularity_unavailable: 零積不抵整發 is applied only to records that say enough for it to bite. Offsets involving such records are granularity-blind and may discharge a lump fault with scattered merit. This is why `granularity_applied` False does not by itself mean the rule was tested and did not bite.
